name: happy-code
description: Guided solo pipeline for one development task end-to-end — grill, spec, tracer-bullet tickets, impact analysis, confirm gate, laziest working implementation, self-review — plus skills to create a ClickUp ticket, to pick up an existing ticket from ClickUp, GitHub or elsewhere, and to play a manual UI test plan on a visible browser with an on-screen check panel. Replies in Thai.
